inputs.prompt: Create ONE 13-second edited sequence with five DISTINCT film shots in exact order; each shot fills the screen, never a grid. <Picture 1> is the opening composition and the sole visual authority: a hand-drawn warm second-hand bookshop interior where Claire (dark wavy hair, hair clips, gray striped sweater, headphones around her neck, backpack) stands at the left bookshelf holding an old book, and Marcel (older man, dark hair, glasses, brown jacket) reads quietly in an armchair in the right rear. <Picture 2> is the exact Claire character design; <Picture 3> is the exact Marcel character design. Preserve the referenced hand-drawn 2D style, warm lamp-lit palette and stable proportions. SHOT 1, 0.0-1.8 seconds: stable medium shot, Claire moves along the shelf and notices one particular old book, while Marcel is visibly reading in the rear before any disturbance. CUT. SHOT 2, 1.8-3.5 seconds: close insert, Claire opens the old book and one cream paper envelope is revealed embedded between the pages; her fingertip touches its edge once. CUT. SHOT 3, 3.5-6.4 seconds: fixed extreme-close face shot of Claire; first a doubtful blink and a small lean closer, then her eyebrows rise and her eyes open in genuine shock, ending on an intake of breath. CUT. SHOT 4, 6.4-9.8 seconds: medium upper-body shot, Claire recoils upright from the old book, shoulders jerk back and her mouth opens for one spontaneous surprised exclamation, then stops. CUT. SHOT 5, 9.8-13.0 seconds: hard-cut reaction shot of Marcel in his same reading position; the scream interrupts him, he closes his book once, sharply looks up, furrows his brow and raises one arm to point toward the front door, the motion complete with a clear endpoint. Clear hard editorial cuts, restrained emotion. No dialogue audio, text, subtitles, invented characters, costume changes, face redesign, red hair, magic effects, photorealism, 3D, split screens, storyboard grid or extra fingers.
